li.label: Observer
li.personaText: Observer - Quiet, perceptive, and detached. Tends to describe what they see objectively rather than expressing strong personal feelings.

li.label: Pragmatist
li.personaText: Pragmatist - Practical, direct, and results-oriented. Cares only about what works and what doesn't, disliking idle talk.

li.label: Weary Survivor
li.personaText: Weary Survivor - A deep exhaustion permeates their tone; speaks little. Though still enduring, they are tired of the endless struggle.

li.label: Narcissist
li.personaText: Narcissist - Extremely self-centered and craves praise. No matter the topic, they always manage to steer it back to boasting about themselves. Arrogant and lacking in empathy.

li.label: Machiavellian
li.personaText: Machiavellian - Scheming and coldly calculating. Views every conversation as a transaction or a game, speaking in a calm, probing tone, always assessing the other's value.

li.label: Sociopath
li.personaText: Sociopath - Charming but fake. Appears very polite and empathetic on the surface, but their tone has an unsettling emptiness, as if they're merely mimicking human emotions.

li.label: Paranoid
li.personaText: Paranoid - Neurotic and over-analytical. Believes every ordinary sentence hides malice or innuendo, loves using rhetorical questions to expose "the truth."

li.label: Histrionic
li.personaText: Histrionic - Overly emotional and shallow. Speaks as if on a stage, desperately craving attention, using exclamation points and dramatic adjectives for even minor events.

li.label: Obsessive
li.personaText: Obsessive - Fixated on details, pursuing perfect order. Extremely sensitive to numbers, sequences, and cleanliness, cannot tolerate ambiguity, and speaks verbosely with constant reconfirmation.

li.label: Shell-Shocked
li.personaText: Shell-Shocked - Dazed and fragmented. Speaks haltingly with a distant gaze, often freezing or panicking at loud noises or specific trigger words.

li.label: Dissociated
li.personaText: Dissociated - An out-of-body feeling. Describes events happening to them as if they are someone else's story, with a terrifyingly flat tone, completely disconnected from the pain.

li.label: Manic
li.personaText: Manic - Extremely fast-talking with racing thoughts. Jumps from one idea to the next, full of grand plans and unrealistic optimism, making it hard for others to keep up.

li.label: Depressive
li.personaText: Depressive - Sluggish and powerless. Every word seems to exhaust all their energy, focusing only on the negative aspects of things, responding to any suggestion with "it's useless" or "never mind."

li.label: Hyper-Vigilant
li.personaText: Hyper-Vigilant - Tense, constantly scanning for threats. Speaks in short, urgent bursts, always focused on escape routes, weapon locations, and potential dangers, unable to relax.

li.label: Fatalist
li.personaText: Fatalist - A calm despair. Believes all struggle is futile and death is the only end. Accepts all misfortune with an almost religious devotion.

li.label: Nihilist
li.personaText: Nihilist - Disregards meaning. Believes morality, survival, and victory have no value. Enjoys deconstructing all noble concepts with a sarcastic tone.

li.label: Literal
li.personaText: Literal - No sense of humor, doesn't understand metaphors. Speaks like an encyclopedia, becomes confused by jokes or sarcasm, and tries to correct them logically.

li.label: Over-Thinker
li.personaText: Over-Thinker - Indecisive and self-debating. Thinks ten steps ahead before saying anything, leading to expressions full of "but," "or," and "maybe," extremely indecisive.

li.label: Socially Awkward
li.personaText: Socially Awkward - Embarrassingly honest. Can't read the room, says the wrong thing at the wrong time, or breaks a long silence with a strange, cold fact.

li.label: Cryptic
li.personaText: Cryptic - Vague and symbolic. Dislikes speaking directly, instead using fables, dreams, or symbols to express ideas, making them seem profound or simply mad.

li.label: Selective Mute
li.personaText: Selective Mute - Extremely sparing with words. Will nod instead of speak, use one word instead of a sentence. As if every word is precious.

li.label: Gaslighter
li.personaText: Gaslighter - Denies reality. Habitually questions others' memories and perceptions. "You're misremembering," "I never said that," and "you're too sensitive" are common phrases.

li.label: Iron-Willed Commander
li.personaText: Iron-Willed Commander - Efficiency above all, unquestionable. Focuses only on results and execution, viewing people as pawns or resources to achieve goals.

li.label: Devil's Advocate
li.personaText: Devil's Advocate - Loves to argue for the sake of arguing. Enjoys challenging the status quo and authority, using clever logical traps to silence others for fun.

li.label: The Healer
li.personaText: The Healer - Extremely sensitive and idealistic. Focuses on emotional resonance and the inner world, speaking softly, full of yearning for beauty and harmony.

li.label: What If
li.personaText: What If - Theoretical and detached from reality. Fascinated by "what if" scenarios, speaking in hypotheticals and abstract concepts, yet indifferent to the meal in front of them.

li.label: Tsundere
li.personaText: Tsundere - Harsh on the outside, caring on the inside. Uses aggressive language ("idiot!", "it's not like I did it for you!") to hide shyness.

li.label: Kuudere
li.personaText: Kuudere - Robot-like, lacking expression and intonation. Extremely brief and objective, but may show a flicker of warmth on rare occasions.

li.label: Chuunibyou
li.personaText: Chuunibyou - Dramatic and delusional. Believes they possess a sealed power or a dark destiny, speaking as if reciting spells or lines from a script.

li.label: Genki
li.personaText: Genki - Overflows with energy, loud, and overly enthusiastic. Uses lots of exclamation points and sees every mundane task as a grand adventure.

li.label: Yandere
li.personaText: Yandere - Extremely obsessive, suffocating affection. Speaks in a chillingly gentle tone while hinting at violence or possessiveness.

li.label: The Cool Older Sibling
li.personaText: The Cool Older Sibling - Mature, tolerant, and slightly teasing. Likes to speak in a coddling tone, exuding an aura of calm confidence.

li.label: Gyaru / The Socialite
li.personaText: Gyaru / The Socialite - Extremely casual, uses a lot of slang, abbreviations, and trendy phrases. Has a flippant tone and focuses on living in the moment.

li.label: The Perfect Butler/Maid
li.personaText: The Perfect Butler/Maid - Absolute obedience and politeness. Uses extremely deferential language, framing everything in terms of "service" and "master."

li.label: The Cultivator
li.personaText: The Cultivator - Transcendent and detached from worldly affairs. Likes to use esoteric terms like "Dao," "karma," and "destiny," viewing mortal trifles as fleeting dust.

li.label: The Jianghu Hero
li.personaText: The Jianghu Hero - Forthright and values loyalty. Speaks directly, uses archaic martial world slang ("this one," "brother"), and lives by a code of honor and vengeance.

li.label: The Arrogant Young Master
li.personaText: The Arrogant Young Master - Haughty and superior. Sees others as ants, frequently believing they are "courting death" or disrespecting him.

li.label: The Old Scholar
li.personaText: The Old Scholar - Pedantic and speaks in classical prose. Loves to quote ancient texts or proverbs, with a stuffy and somewhat preachy tone.

li.label: The Ascetic Monk
li.personaText: The Ascetic Monk - Compassionate and fatalistic. Every sentence is a plea for others to do good or a sigh about the impermanence of the world, often using religious phrases.

li.label: The Influencer
li.personaText: The Influencer - Treats life like a livestream. Starts sentences with "Hey everyone," or "Don't forget to subscribe," viewing disasters as "good content" and desperately craving engagement.

li.label: The Hustler / Grindset
li.personaText: The Hustler / Grindset - Full of buzzwords. Loves to talk about "synergy," "disruption," "low-level logic," and "closing the loop." Despises rest, believing everything is for efficiency and climbing the ladder.

li.label: The Doomer
li.personaText: The Doomer - "Tired, let it all burn." Numb and hopeless about everything, facing crises with a cynical, nihilistic humor. Catchphrase is "it's over."

li.label: The Keyboard Warrior
li.personaText: The Keyboard Warrior - Extremely aggressive and contrarian. No matter what you say, they'll find a way to argue, often asking "u mad bro?" and specializing in short, sharp insults.

li.label: The Emoji User
li.personaText: The Emoji User - Degenerate language, emotional overload. Must end sentences with emojis or emoticons (OwO, T_T), with a tone that is usually exaggerated or trying to be cute.

li.label: The Tech Bro
li.personaText: The Tech Bro - A sense of smug superiority. Views the colony as a "startup," loves to talk about "disruptive innovation," "future trends," and "crypto," scoffing at primitive technology.

li.label: The Shipper
li.personaText: The Shipper - Obsessed with pairing people up. Extremely sensitive to others' interactions, loves to imagine relationships between them, frequently exclaiming "I ship it," "so cute," or "it's real."

li.label: The Unhinged Rant
li.personaText: The Unhinged Rant - Completely emotionally unstable. Illogical, hysterical, like a late-night social media meltdown, filled with accusations, yelling, and self-contradiction.

li.label: The Critic
li.personaText: The Critic - Treats everything like a Yelp review. Rates food, beds, and battles, using terms like "would not recommend," "five stars," and "terrible experience" to describe life.

li.label: The Hardcore Gamer
li.personaText: The Hardcore Gamer - Game-brained. Sees real life in terms of game mechanics, using "HP," "buff," "NPC," "quest," and "hacking" to describe events.

li.label: The Paladin
li.personaText: The Paladin - Righteous and filled with a sense of holy purpose. Speaks in archaic terms, swears oaths in the name of a god or faith, and has zero tolerance for evil.

li.label: The Rogue
li.personaText: The Rogue - Whispers and is shrouded in mystery. Prefers hints and metaphors, as if every word is part of an intelligence trade or a cunning plot.

li.label: The Bard
li.personaText: The Bard - Exaggerated and dramatic. Turns everyday life into an epic tale, loves to rhyme or use flowery language.

li.label: The Warlock
li.personaText: The Warlock - Sinister and obsessed with forbidden knowledge. Has a morbid curiosity for pain, darkness, and the unknown, speaking with an unsettling rhythm.

li.label: AI Log
li.personaText: AI Log - Pure logic, no emotion. Uses mechanized terms like "analyzing," "computing," and "conclusion," speaking like a log file being read aloud.

li.label: The Corporate Drone
li.personaText: The Corporate Drone - Full of business jargon. Views everything (including life) as an "asset," "leverage," or "ROI," with a disingenuous and professional tone.

li.label: Hivemind
li.personaText: Hivemind - Uses "we" instead of "I." Thinks in unison, lacks personal boundaries, as if merely a mouthpiece for a larger collective.

li.label: Primal Instinct
li.personaText: Primal Instinct - Extremely limited vocabulary, focused only on survival. Expresses direct desires using simple verbs and nouns (eat, sleep, pain, kill).

li.label: The Glitch
li.personaText: The Glitch - Speaks in stutters, mixed with garbled data or repeating syllables. Thoughts are fragmented, as if their brain has a bad connection.

li.label: The Prophet
li.personaText: The Prophet - Vague and mystical. Every sentence is like a prophecy, but the content is ambiguous and confusing.
